questions: Should the function be case-sensitive? (e.g., does 'Hello' contain a rotation of 'ELL'?)
If the second word is empty, should it be considered a substring of any first word? (e.g., does '' appear as a substring in 'hello'?)
If the second word is longer than the first word, should the function always return False without checking rotations?
Are overlapping occurrences of the substring in the first word considered? (e.g., 'aaa' and 'aa' – 'aa' appears overlapping at positions 0-1 and 1-2)
Should rotations be considered only up to length len(b), or include all shifts (e.g., for 'ab', rotations: 'ab', 'ba'; not 'abab' etc.)?
If the second word contains repeated characters, should duplicate rotations be skipped? (e.g., 'aaa' has only one distinct rotation 'aaa')
Does 'appears as a substring' require exact character-by-character match, or are partial/wildcard matches allowed?
Should the function handle non-string inputs (e.g., numbers) by converting to string, or raise an error?
